what: THE ASSEMBLY POINT. A folder holding a COPY of every intention+why in the system — the homeless intentions from `intentions-not-beside-code/` plus every beside-code `intention+why.json` in the cairn repo, one file each, byte-identical to its source. Nothing is authored here. A hand-written intention in this folder is a defect, not a contribution, and is deleted on the next run of the door.
why:
Akien, 2026-07-22: 'the CairnCommons intentions folder becomes the place the other intentions are assembled into.' This is the outer row of the three-scale projector recursion — ticket (history -> state window), component (a component's intentions + tickets -> its charter as summarized design), system (all sources -> here). Same move each time: compile a bounded view over an append-only source so no mind re-derives it by reading everything (Law 1).

What it is FOR is the seed claim: take this one folder to a bare machine and regrow the system. That only works if the view is compiled over BOTH sources — the beside-code charters alone regrow a repo that does not run, because everything that made a machine ready to run it lives in `intentions-not-beside-code/`.
the_roots_surface_first: RETIRED 2026-07-31. This clause described a timestamp-ordered COMPILE that put telos.md and core-values.md at the top of a single generated artifact. That artifact (`_model.json`) is deleted and the folder now holds plain copies, so there is no order to place them in — the roots are simply here, under their own names, which is what the clause was protecting. The part that still stands and always was the point: there is no separate `values/` container, because carrying this folder to a bare machine must not leave the frame behind.
derived_never_authored: THIS IS A VIEWING SURFACE ONLY (Akien, 2026-08-06). The invariant is not that one program writes here — it is that every non-`_` file is DERIVED from a source and nothing is authored. Several derived writers are legitimate and were sanctioned in the same breath: the copier regenerating the whole folder, and a formalization step updating the one intention it changed 'rather than launching the compiler for it' (sanctioned, unbuilt — today every refresh is a whole-folder copy). To change what is here, change the source — a file in `intentions-not-beside-code/` or a charter beside its code — then let the copy follow, via `bin/cmd/compile` or the recompile gate that /intent pokes before it reads. THE DOOR IOU IS CLOSED as of 2026-07-31: `cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/copy_to_lab` is built and proven, and under its teeth a hand-edited copy is overwritten and a hand-added file removed. What is still convention rather than physics is narrower than it used to read here: regeneration makes a hand-edit TRANSIENT, not impossible, and nothing announces one while it lives — ticket the-lab-is-derived-never-authored, whose tooth compares this folder to its sources WITHOUT writing, because running the copier to find out destroys the evidence.
owner: the store owns the collection; `cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/compiler.py::copy_to_lab` is the door that regenerates it whole, built and green 2026-07-31, and today the only writer in fact. It is not claimed as the only legitimate one — see `derived_never_authored`. Files prefixed `_` (this charter) are SOURCES, not copies — the door never writes or deletes them.
template: not applicable — records here are projections, shaped by the projector, not authored against a template. The template that matters is the one in `intentions-not-beside-code/_charter+why.json`, which governs the sources.
notes_on_the_store: Emptiness is the correct resting state until the projector exists. An empty compiled view is honest; a hand-maintained one that LOOKS compiled is the drift this whole design is built to make impossible.

The middle row of the recursion stays authored on purpose: a component's charter is the precipitate of design conversation, not a compilation of its tickets. Whether that ever changes is deliberately open (Law 3, guess and adjust).
provenance: Emptied and re-chartered 2026-07-22, when the last hand-authored files left for `intentions-not-beside-code/` — the four I-*.md spanning intentions plus the two roots. Akien: 'that's why I said they'd go in intentions-not-beside-code.' The folder's job changed from holding intentions to assembling them.
